class.name: NNBlackboardSensor
class.brief_description: Reads a numeric or boolean blackboard key and maps it into [code]0..1[/code].
class.description: Reads [member key] from the owning root's [NNBlackboard] and normalizes it between [member range_min_value] and [member range_max_value] into a [code]0..1[/code] sensor value. Works under [NNAgent], [NNBTRoot], and [NNSTRoot]. Use this when your game already stores values like health, threat, or boolean flags on the blackboard and you want considerations to score them without writing extra sensor scripts. Missing or non-numeric values fall back to [member default_value].

members.member: Fallback raw value used before normalization when [member key] is missing, [code]null[/code], or not a [bool], [int], or [float].
Upper bound of the input range, mapping to [code]1.0[/code]. The default [code]0..1[/code] range maps a [bool] key directly to [code]0.0[/code] or [code]1.0[/code].
Lower bound of the input range, mapping to [code]0.0[/code].
